XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Engine fuel supply

  • Device: Fuel pressure regulator

  • Fault: The red engine fault warning light comes on. Occasionally, the vehicle exhibits significantly reduced performance with a lack of response from the accelerator pedal and engine stalling whilst driving; the engine restarts immediately and runs smoothly.

  • Errors detected by self-diagnosis: P1671 (Fuel pressure regulator - Fault)

  • Cause: Fuel pressure regulator connection compromised

• Action: Check the condition and correct operation of the fuel pressure regulator and, if necessary, replace it

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The regulator is located on the high-pressure fuel pump. In this case, the regulator was found to have a damaged connection; following its replacement, the problem was permanently resolved.
